# vendor/

Third-party code committed into the repo on purpose, so the app has no
runtime dependency on a CDN for these.

## qrcode.js

- **qrcode-generator** v1.4.4 (+ its UTF-8 mode appended)
- Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase — MIT licence
- <https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator>

Used by `admin.html` to draw the shop's check-in QR code entirely in the
browser. Nothing is uploaded to a QR service, so the shop's URL never
leaves the device.

Do not edit this file. To update it:

    npm pack qrcode-generator@<version>
    tar xzf qrcode-generator-<version>.tgz
    cat package/qrcode.js package/qrcode_UTF8.js > vendor/qrcode.js
